name: sticky-gallery
blurb: Hero section sticks during scroll, revealing gallery columns below.
description: A full-page layout using CSS sticky positioning with ReactLenis smooth scrolling. Hero section remains visible while scrolling past a 3-column image gallery grid below.
use_when: Landing pages or portfolio showcases where sticky hero remains visible during image gallery scroll.
avoid_when: When custom content and images are needed; this is a hardcoded template layout.
a11y: Semantic HTML with images having alt text; smooth scroll behavior via ReactLenis.
